description: List AniList characters or staff members whose birthday (month/day) is today, most favourited first. Paginated — a single day can have well over a thousand entries, so check `hasNextPage` before treating a page as the full list. Returns character-shaped or staff-shaped objects for kind: CHARACTER/STAFF respectively, but a lighter fetch than get_character/get_staff: it does NOT include those tools' `media`/`staffMedia` filmography, nor each entry's bio (`description`) unless you set `includeDescription` — call get_character/get_staff by ID for an entry's full roles/works and bio, don't read a missing filmography here as 'none'.

includeDescription.description: Also fetch each result's full bio (`description`). Kept off by default — a bio can run to several thousand characters, and always including it would burn tokens on text you may not need; use get_character/get_staff for a single entry's full bio instead.

kind.description: Whether to list characters or staff members.

page.description: Page number for pagination. AniList's paginated connections (search results, a title's characters/staff/reviews, activity feeds, forum comments) reject a page whose page × perPage exceeds ~5000 entries with an upstream error, so paging that deep fails rather than returning more results.

perPage.description: Results per page (max 50, AniList's own ceiling — it silently clamps anything higher).

name: get_todays_birthdays

isFavourite.description: [Requires login] Whether this character or staff member is in the caller's favourites. Has a brief read-after-write lag on AniList's own backend — confirmed live, a re-check right after toggle_favourite can briefly still show the pre-toggle value.

title: Get today's birthday characters or staff
